defs.en: Against.

defs.en: In the company of; alongside, close to; near to.

defs.en: Used to add supplemental information, especially to indicate simultaneous happening, or immediate succession or consequence.

defs.en: In support of.

ja: (人を)理解して、～に味方して、～に寄りそって、～に付いて。

defs.en: Along, together with others, in a group, etc.

defs.en: Used in phrases with existential there when the semantic subject is (usually third-person) plural.

defs.en: Excluding the person(s) being addressed. (This is the exclusive we.)

defs.en: Including the person(s) being addressed. (This is the inclusive we.)
defs.ex: We need to have a talk, you and me.

defs.en: Any other entity that the speaker is a part of or identifies with, such as place of employment or education, nation, region, language, etc.

defs.en: People in general.

（paternal we, 患者や子供に対して you の代わりに用いる。）あなたは。（親愛の情を示すが時に軽蔑的に響くので、対等の者以上に対しては用いない。）
（主に主語に用いる）すべての人々。

defs.en: Designates the speaker(s)/writer(s) as belonging to or constituting the stated category of people.

defs.en: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.
defs.ex: Do not forget, will you?

defs.en: To be able to, to have the capacity to.
defs.ex: Unfortunately, only one of these gloves will actually fit over my hand.

defs.en: Expressing a present tense or perfect tense with some conditional or subjective weakening: "will turn out to", "must by inference".
defs.ex: He will be home by now. He always gets home before 6 o'clock.

defs.en: To habitually do (a given action).
defs.ex: Boys will be boys.

defs.en: To choose or agree to (do something); used to express intention but without any temporal connotations, often in questions and negation.

ja: (主語の意思、意向)-しよう。cf.話者の意思:shall

defs.en: One's independent faculty of choice; the ability to be able to exercise one's choice or intention.

defs.en: The act of choosing to do something; a person’s conscious intent or volition.

defs.en: One's intention or decision; someone's orders or commands.

defs.en: Firmness of purpose, fixity of intent
A formal declaration of one's intent concerning the disposal of one's property and holdings after death; the legal document stating such wishes.
Which, especially which of an open-ended set of possibilities.

defs.en: Which.

defs.en: Any ... that; all ... that; whatever.

defs.en: Emphasises that something is noteworthy or remarkable in quality or degree, in either a good or bad way; may be used in combination with certain other determiners, especially 'a', less often 'some'.

defs.en: Used to form exclamations indicating that something is remarkable, in either a good or bad way.
defs.ex: What nonsense!

defs.en: Which thing, event, circumstance, etc.: used in asking for the specification of an identity, quantity, quality, etc.
defs.ex: Hammer in that nail —What with? I didn't bring my set of tools.

defs.en: That which; those that; the thing(s) that.
defs.ex: He knows what he wants and what to do to get it.

defs.en: Anything that; all that; whatever.
defs.ex: I will do what I can to help you.

defs.en: That; which; who.

ja: （疑問形容詞）何～。；what time 何時

defs.en: In what way; to what extent.
defs.ex: What does it matter?

defs.en: Used before a prepositional phrase to emphasise that something is taken into consideration as a cause or reason; usually used in combination with 'with' (see what with), and much less commonly with other prepositions.
An expression of surprise or disbelief.
defs.ex: What! That’s amazing!

defs.en: What do you want? An abrupt, usually unfriendly enquiry as to what a person desires.
defs.ex: What? I'm busy.

defs.en: What did you say? I beg your pardon? This usage is often considered impolite, with the more polite "Pardon?" or "Excuse me?" preferred.
defs.ex: — Could I have some of those aarrrrrr mmmm ... — What?

defs.en: Indicating a guess or approximation, or a pause to try to recall information.
defs.ex: I must have been, what, about five years old.

defs.en: The identity of a thing, as an answer to a question of what.
Something that is addressed by what, as opposed to a person, addressed by who.
Emphasizes the truth of an assertion made to contradict an evidently false assumption held by the listener.
defs.ex: Pitch contour: low [wʌt˩], low-dipping [wʌt˨˩]

defs.en: Used to invite agreement or acknowledgment when something is assumed to be straightforward or already obvious to begin with; similar in function to “right?” and “as you know”.
defs.ex: Pitch contour: low [wʌt˩], low-dipping [wʌt˨˩]

defs.en: Used after a direct assertion to reinforce a disagreeing opinion.
defs.ex: Pitch contour: low [wʌt˩], low-dipping [wʌt˨˩]

defs.en: At what time? At which time? Upon which occasion or circumstance? Used to introduce direct or indirect questions about time.
defs.ex: When will they arrive?

defs.ex: The site's all bugged. Fix when?

defs.en: At an earlier time and under different, usually less favorable, circumstances.
defs.ex: He's mister high and mighty now, but I remember him when.

defs.en: At which, on which, during which: often omitted or replaced with that.
defs.ex: That was the day when the Twin Towers fell.

defs.en: The time at, on or during which.

defs.en: At (or as soon as) that time that; at the (or any and every) time that; if.

defs.en: During the time that; at the time of the action of the following clause or participle phrase.

defs.en: At what time; at which time.
defs.ex: I am here till Friday, when [i.e. at which time] I leave for Senegal.

defs.en: Since; given the fact that; considering that.
defs.ex: I don't see the point of putting up Christmas decorations when I am the only person who is going to see them.

defs.en: Whereas; although; at the same time as; in spite of the fact that.

defs.en: What time; which time.

ja: （関係代名詞的に後文を伴って）そのとき。

defs.en: The time at which something happens.

simple subjunctive of be

ja: 先行詞が主語である場合。

defs.en: What one or ones (of those mentioned or implied).

ja: （2種のものからの選択）どちら。
